Information on how to configure and run the JAR files can be found in the [README.md](https://github.com/md-173/faf-test-harness/blob/main/README.md)

To run the mocks against a real `faf-ice-adapter` with no FAF account and no lobby, see [runbook §2](https://github.com/md-173/faf-test-harness/blob/main/documentation/operations/harness-runbook.md#2-running-the-game-against-an-adapter-no-lobby-required).

Note: This is an unstable release, the interface is likely to change in ways that break previous usage.
